archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Process lifecycle and identity checks are the main correctness risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new python/larch/bgjob package and process_identity touchpoint. Focus on whether daemon, child, owner, and registry identity checks fail closed and whether result-env writes remain atomic and newline-safe. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
